artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V$ be a compact $C^\infty$ manifold and let $\mathrm{Diff}^\infty(V)$ denote the group of $C^\infty$ diffeomorphisms of $V$, equipped with its standard $C^\infty$ topology. Fix $f \in \mathrm{Diff}^\infty(V)$ and let $U \subset \mathrm{Diff}^\infty(V)$ be a $C^\infty$ neighborhood of the identity. Define the local conjugacy class
$$O_{f,U} = \{\, g \circ f \circ g^{-1} : g \in U \,\} \subset \mathrm{Diff}^\infty(V).$$
A translation $T_\alpha$ on the torus $\mathbb{T}^n = \mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$ is the map $x \mapsto x+\alpha \pmod{\mathbb{Z}^n}$, and $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}^n$ is called Diophantine if there exist constants $C>0$ and $\tau \geq 0$ such that $|\langle k,\alpha\rangle - m| \geq C|k|^{-\tau}$ for all $k \in \mathbb{Z}^n \setminus \{0\}$ and $m \in \mathbb{Z}$.

Prove or disprove: If $O_{f,U}$ is a (smoothly embedded) submanifold of $\mathrm{Diff}^\infty(V)$ of finite codimension, then $V$ is diffeomorphic to a torus $\mathbb{T}^n$ and $f$ is $C^\infty$-conjugate to a Diophantine translation of $\mathbb{T}^n$.
artifact.category_tag: Converse KAM and conjugacy classes of diffeomorphisms
artifact.status_search_result: A direct resolution of Herman's converse-KAM question—characterizing diffeomorphisms with finite-codimension local conjugacy class as Diophantine translations on tori—does not appear in the literature found. Related local rigidity results show that a $C^\infty$ small perturbation of a Diophantine translation on $\mathbb{T}^n$ that preserves rotation vector is smoothly conjugate to the translation, which gives partial evidence for one direction, but the global converse statement (forcing $V=\mathbb{T}^n$ from the finite-codimension hypothesis) is not known to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Local Rigidity of Diophantine Translations in Higher-dimensional Tori
status_evidence.snippet: Given a Diophantine rotation α on T^d, any C^∞-small perturbation that does not destroy all orbits with rotation vector α is smoothly conjugate to the rigid rotation.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result supporting one direction of Herman's converse problem in the torus case.

status_evidence.title: Around the stability of KAM tori (Eliasson–Fayad–Krikorian)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of stability and rigidity results around Diophantine quasi-periodic dynamics.
status_evidence.claim: No statement of a complete proof of Herman's converse-KAM conjugacy-class conjecture is given.
